correctness.rationale: The endpoint reduction is proved for distinct equal-length four-mers. Greedy worst length is obtained by exhaustive tie-recursion, optimum by an exact Hamiltonian overlap DP. Both C++ implementations executed from included package paths: one on 1,443,279 endpoint states and the independent literal-strings checker on 1,703,924 string states. Both exhaustively verified 39,202 sets, the same per-size maxima/counts and exactly masks 1343, 5431, 60584, 64672. A literal 11-bit host and a legal 17-bit seven-merge trace confirm attainability and an elementary window count gives the sharp optimal lower bound. No extrapolation outside size eight.

value.rationale: The minimum number of reads required to violate a 3/2 ratio is a meaningful sharp threshold for a canonical fixed alphabet, fixed read width in the ongoing fixed-width Greedy approximation problem. The finite classification enumerates all smallest adversarial inputs and their exact reversal/complement symmetry orbit, useful as small benchmarking counterexamples; it is not an arbitrary sample of parameter choices, and the result is not a simple reformulation of known width-three or complete-sixteen-read computations.
